title: Motor Policy Schedule
key_sentences: This schedule forms part of your policy and must be read together with the policy booklet MP-2026.
Please check the details below and tell us within 14 days if anything is incorrect.
The additional excess applies only when the vehicle is driven by a named driver under the age of 25.
The vehicle must be kept in a locked garage overnight at the address shown.
A telematics device must remain fitted and working for the whole period of insurance.
Social, domestic and pleasure use and commuting to a single place of work are covered, but business use is not.
You may cancel within 14 days of receiving this schedule and receive a full refund if no claim has been made.

rows: Accidental damage Repair or replacement of your vehicle after an accident
Fire and theft Including theft of keys from your home
Third-party liability Injury to others and damage to their property
Windscreen Repair or replacement of glass
Personal belongings Items carried in the vehicle
Courtesy car While your vehicle is repaired by an approved garage

notes: Two-page motor insurance schedule. Letterhead (left name, right 2 lines) is furniture; bottom-left policy number and bottom-centre registration line are listed once, 'n/N' once per page. Level-2 headings are SMALL CAPS and letter-spaced: text given in source case (compare case-insensitively). The cover table has cells of TWO LINES (cover name + description), given joined by one space. The endorsement paragraphs begin with RUN-IN headings (level 3), recorded without their trailing period.
